messages:
maria.gonzalez: Heads up — we started getting a bunch of SCIM deprovision failures around 10:03 UTC after the IdP reported a JWKS rotation. Customers report users lost RBAC bindings. Logs show SAML assertion audience mismatches and some KMS decrypt errors for external_id lookups. Anyone seen this pattern before? :warning:

alex.johnson: Can you paste a sample error? is it a 403 from the IdP or our side failing to validate signature?

maria.gonzalez: Here's a redacted stack snippet from production: 
```
WARN  auth.saml - Assertion validation failed: audience mismatch (expected https://redwood.example/sso, got https://idp.example)
ERROR scim.provisioner - deprovision failed user=U12345 status=409 detail="external_id duplicate"
ERROR kms.client - decrypt failed: ctx-mismatch KeyAlias=projects/prod/keys/scim
```

samir_patel: Two things jump out: 1) audience mismatch usually means the Issuer or AssertionConsumerService URL changed on the IdP side. 2) KMS decrypt ctx mismatch could be a separate rotation issue (maybe credentials for SCIM backfill job). Did the IdP rotate signing alg or KID? idp-bot: JWKS_ROTATION detected for idp.example at 2026-03-21T09:58:10Z (new keys available).

liz_h: I just repro'd in staging — when the IdP rotated keys they published a JWKS that dropped the previous KID immediately and also changed alg from RS256 -> PS256. Our SAML validator is strict on alg/KID and falls back to cached JWKS only if enabled.

alex.johnson: That explains audience mismatch? alg change shouldn't change audience though. Could the IdP also have changed the Audience/Issuer value in the assertion template? Ask IdP team for assertion sample.

maria.gonzalez: @idp-team I've asked for the raw SAML assertion. Meanwhile, staging debug: when we validated signature with PS256 our library threw UnsupportedAlgorithm, which we bubble up as validation failure and then treat as audience mismatch in the same codepath (bad error mapping, filed a ticket).

samir_patel: Short-term mitigation: enable `allow_legacy_jwks_cache` and `accept_algaiters: ["PS256","RS256"]` in the SSO config to accept the new alg and fallback to cached keys for 5m. I'll open a canary PR. Long-term: update verification library to support multiple algs and proper error classification.

liz_h: Also need to handle SCIM duplicate external_id: looks like deprovision retrier retried before KMS backfill completed. Suggest running a one-off backfill job `scim-deprov-backfill --since=2026-03-21T09:50Z` after the key fix.

alex.johnson: Security question: was the JWKS rotation expected? If there was an emergency key compromise, we need to run vuln triage and notify impacted customers per policy. @security oncall can you confirm?

maria.gonzalez: @alex.johnson IdP said rotation was automated and expected, but they changed template concurrently — they acknowledged the audience field tweak. I'm treating it as misconfiguration, not compromise, but want sec confirmation.

samir_patel: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/identity/compare/allow-jwks-fallback-ps256 — includes toggle to accept PS256 and use cached jwks for 300s. Will run canary in EU region first.

liz_h: Patch tested in staging: SCIM deprovision retries succeed once signature verification accepts PS256; KMS decrypt error still needs ops to rekey the SCIM service account or re-run rewrap job. Ops: pls check `kms.rewrap --service=scim` job status.

idp-bot: Reminder: Incident policy requires a postmortem if >50 users were affected for >30m. Current estimate ~18 users impacted, incident not yet escalated.

maria.gonzalez: Action items: 1) samir enable canary toggle in prod EU 09:35 UTC (in 10m) 2) ops run KMS rewrap for scim svc account and confirm decrypt health 3) liz run `scim-deprov-backfill` once KMS green 4) alex/security confirm no compromise. I'll message CS to prepare customer comms if count increases.

alex.johnson: I'll own security triage. Immediate checklist: check IdP rotation logs, confirm private key compromise false, verify key rotation was pushed through their automated pipeline. If anything suspicious, escalate to legal.

samir_patel: Canary enabled in EU, metrics look good (no new validation failures). Rolling to US in 5m. :thumbsup:

liz_h: KMS rewrap started, ETA ~7m. Monitoring decrypts now.

maria.gonzalez: Good progress. Once backfill completes we'll run a quick audit to verify RBAC bindings restored: `select count(*) from rbac_bindings where restored_after='2026-03-21T09:50'`

alex.johnson: Security update: no indicators of compromise; rotation logs show automation. Closing vuln triage for now, will attach notes to the incident ticket.

maria.gonzalez: Postmortem owner: @maria.gonzalez. Tentative RFO: IdP rotated JWKS + concurrently changed assertion audience template -> our validation was strict and retriers caused duplicate/deprov races plus KMS rewrap timing exposed backfill gap. We'll propose: better alg support, clearer error taxonomy, and a SCIM deprov circuit-breaker to avoid duplicates.

liz_h: I'll open the follow-up tickets and add to next sprint. Thanks everyone. :pray:
